# Script API reference

Every global, function, method, value type, callback and registered type a box-engine Luau script can use. Each page is generated from the declarations the editor's luau-lsp completion uses (`box script types`), so hover text in your editor and these pages say the same thing. New to scripting? Start with the scripting guide (`docs/guide/scripting.md`).

643 items. Regenerate with `box script docs --out docs/reference` (engine) or `box script docs --project <dir>` (a project's own types).

## Globals and types

| Name | Page | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`Quat`](core.md#quat) | `core` | A rotation (unit quaternion). |
| [`Quat`](core.md#quat-1) | `core` | Constructors of rotations. |
| [`Color`](core.md#color) | `core` | A colour with linear channels from 0 to 1 (alpha 1 is opaque). |
| [`Color`](core.md#color-1) | `core` | Constructors of colours. |
| [`log`](core.md#log) | `core` | Messages in the editor's Console and the terminal, prefixed with the script's path. |
| [`wait`](core.md#wait) | `core` | Suspends the running task for `seconds` of game time (default 0) and returns the seconds actually waited. |
| [`wait_frames`](core.md#wait_frames) | `core` | Suspends the running task for `frames` frames (default 1). |
| [`wait_until`](core.md#wait_until) | `core` | Suspends the running task until `condition()` returns true (checked once per frame) and returns true, or returns false after `timeout` seconds of game time. |
| [`task`](core.md#task) | `core` | Tasks: functions that run alongside the frame loop and may `wait`. |
| [`Entity`](entity.md#entity-1) | `Entity` | A handle to an entity (an object in the scene). |
| [`world`](world.md#world-1) | `world` | The game world: spawn and find entities, query them by component, read and change resources. |
| [`time`](time.md#time-1) | `time` | Game time: the frame's delta, elapsed time, time scale and pause. |
| [`app`](app.md#app-1) | `app` | The running application. |
| [`input`](input.md#input-1) | `input` | Player input: named actions (keyboard, mouse and gamepad bindings), raw keys and mouse, cursor lock. |
| [`QueryOptions`](physics.md#queryoptions) | `physics` | Which colliders a query sees. |
| [`RayHit`](physics.md#rayhit) | `physics` | A ray hit. |
| [`ShapeHit`](physics.md#shapehit) | `physics` | A shape cast hit. |
| [`SlideOptions`](physics.md#slideoptions) | `physics` | Options of `physics.move_and_slide`: the capsule's size, what blocks it and how it walks. |
| [`SlideResult`](physics.md#slideresult) | `physics` | Where `physics.move_and_slide` left the capsule. |
| [`physics`](physics.md#physics-1) | `physics` | Spatial queries against colliders, kinematic movement, and forces on rigid bodies. |
| [`character`](character.md#character-1) | `character` | Kinematic characters: entities with a `KinematicCharacter` component, moved by the engine every fixed step. |
| [`events`](events.md#events-1) | `events` | Events between scripts and the engine: registered event types and script-only signals. |
| [`UiNode`](ui.md#uinode) | `ui` | A handle to a node of the game UI (returned by `ui.add`, `ui.find`, `ui.children`, events). |
| [`UiTarget`](ui.md#uitarget) | `ui` | A node argument: a `UiNode`, or a node `id` string (looked up like `ui.find(id)`, failing when there is none). |
| [`UiEventKind`](ui.md#uieventkind) | `ui` | What happened to a node: a button clicked, a slider changed, a toggle toggled, focus gained or lost, or back pressed (Escape, Backspace, gamepad East) in a modal (the event is on the modal root). |
| [`UiEvent`](ui.md#uievent) | `ui` | A UI event, as `ui.on` handlers receive it. |
| [`ui`](ui.md#ui-1) | `ui` | The game UI: menus, HUDs and labels over the game, built from documents (JSON text or tables) and changed through setters. |
| [`strings`](strings.md#strings-1) | `strings` | Localized text from the project's string tables. |
| [`scenes`](scenes.md#scenes-1) | `scenes` | Runtime scenes: switch levels, load and unload scenes additively. |
| [`AnimationLayer`](animation.md#animationlayer) | `animation` | One clip playing in a blend (during a crossfade there are two). |
| [`animation`](animation.md#animation-1) | `animation` | Skeletal animation: state machine parameters, direct clip playback, playback state and joints. |
| [`SaveSlot`](save.md#saveslot) | `save` | A save file, as `save.slots` lists it. |
| [`SaveResult`](save.md#saveresult) | `save` | The outcome of a save or load request, as `save.on` handlers receive it. |
| [`save`](save.md#save-1) | `save` | Save games: snapshots of the running world in named slots. |
| [`data`](data.md#data-1) | `data` | Data tables: JSON files (`*.data.json`) as read-only Luau tables. |
| [`particles`](particles.md#particles-1) | `particles` | Particle effects: one-shot bursts and control of `ParticleEmitter` entities. |
| [`camera`](camera.md#camera-1) | `camera` | The active camera's projection: world points to screen pixels and screen points to world rays (picking). |
| [`PropertyDecl`](script-modules.md#propertydecl) | Script modules | One declared script property: what each entry of a module's `properties` table takes. |
| [`ScriptSelf`](script-modules.md#scriptself) | Script modules | The `self` table of a running script instance (one per entity with a `Script`). |
| [`ScriptModule`](script-modules.md#scriptmodule) | Script modules | The table a gameplay script file returns. |
| [`RuleIntent`](rules.md#ruleintent) | Script rules | One intent a rule turns into parts: an entity with a `ScriptIntent` naming the rule file. |
| [`RuleComponents`](rules.md#rulecomponents) | Script rules | The components a part gets, by name: each a patch over the component's default values. |
| [`RuleTransform`](rules.md#ruletransform) | Script rules | Where a part goes, relative to its owner (each field optional). |
| [`RuleOut`](rules.md#ruleout) | Script rules | What a rule run produces: parts and warnings. |
| [`RuleModule`](rules.md#rulemodule) | Script rules | The table a rule file returns. |
